target_name: Two-Sided Hidden Capital With Reporting Restraint
rationale: This is the third pass through the same "long clean self-built innovator minus short bloated acquirer" template already tested twice in the archive (Clean Innovator Minus Bloated Acquirer, Two-Sided Hidden Capital Versus Recognized Bloat), with the only change being that the same income-minus-cash accrual is passed through TS_RANK — a component already tested in two other archive signals — so it is a permutation of existing pieces rather than a substantively different construction.

The construction is internally consistent (both conservatism components enter with the correct sign under NEG, and the hidden-capital leg remains a binary conjunction) and it is motivated by a concrete, testable diagnosis — that nested MINs thin the extreme deciles — making the additive-within-leg aggregation a genuinely new structural test rather than a relabeled variant.

Because the working-capital rank enters negatively on the long side and positively on the short side, the additive aggregation algebraically collapses the "two-sided contrast" into a simple linear composite (roughly rank(hidden) − rank(intan) − 2·rank(WC)), so the expression contradicts the stated hypothesis of preserving the two-sided structure and amounts to an operator swap on an already-tested signal.

target_name: Hidden Capital With Net Recognition Restraint
rationale: Netting operating liabilities against operating assets is an economically defensible and correctly signed one-term refinement of the archive's strongest leg, though the motivating claim that "the liability side alone fails" understates that the liability conjunction still produced t-alpha 3.68, so the expected incremental information is modest.

target_name: Recognized Capital Ratio With Restraint Filter
rationale: This simply conjoins two already-evaluated archive components (Hidden Capital Per Recognized Capital and the own-history accrual restraint leg) with only a cosmetic change of denominator, so it tests little beyond what the pair of prior results already implies.

It is a fourth instance of the same two-sided MIN template and overlaps heavily with the concurrently proposed net-working-capital refinement, while the stated justification — wider coverage from avoiding cash-flow-statement items — is weak because the archive's comparable at-scaled, non-oancf signals already reach ~0.12 coverage, so little new information is expected.
